source.note: Kenney ship-pirate-medium (GLB with the kit colormap; License.txt in the zip: CC0). Two-masted pirate ship with a bowsprit jib and a stern castle. Height 20 m keel to masthead (the mast tops of a medium sailing ship sit about 20 m up) gives a 21.3 m length bowsprit to stern and a 9.6 m beam (chunky toy proportions, beam about twice a real ship's). y = 0 is the keel; the waterline sits at about y = 1.8 m (the lower hull chine, where the dark underbody band ends), so a film sinks the ship 1.8 m into its water plane. Kenney's black sails with a bone-white skull are kept: tan hull planks, red rails and masts, dark brown sails and pennants (sails and pennants are one-sided, drawn double-sided). Static, no clips.
